messages:
Liz W: Heads-up — joint summit next month with CloudZen + EdgeForge. Need a quick preflight: speakers, demo fallback, and swag handoff. Who's owning the hardware pickup?
Marco R: I can own hardware pickup from EdgeForge. Shipping ETA to SF booth Wed 7pm. Need contact for customs docs.
Priya S: I have the marketplace folks on standby for a co-announcement draft. Can we lock the time for the 20-min joint webinar slot?
Alex N: Booth power and rack space confirmed: 2U reserved, 3x 120V circuits. Also confirmed table for live invites.
Jordan K: Demo owner here — plan A is live model on EdgeForge box (quantized). Plan B is pre-recorded fallback + local container. Need a test network that mimics throttled bandwidth.
Liz W: @Marco share EdgeForge contact pls. Also we need speaker bios + headshots by EOD Tue. Priya, can marketing push draft co-announcement by Wed?
Marco R: EdgeForge contact: rachel@edgeforge.com (ops). Shipping paperwork needs HS codes and serial numbers. I'll attach manifest in this thread after pickup.
Priya S: Yup, draft to you both by Wed morning. Will include marketplace listing timeline: needs legal signoff by Fri to hit promo window.
Jordan K: Quick checklist for demo kit — please confirm these are packed:
```
- EdgeForge appliance x1 (S/N 12033)
- Power brick + 3m C13 cable
- NVMe drive with demo images
- USB-A dongle for network config
- HDMI + USB-C to HDMI adapter
- Rugged flight case + foam inserts
```
Liz W: We'll add swag inventory to the checklist. Alex, can you confirm who at on-site venue will accept the crate if we ship day-ahead?
Alex N: Venue contact is Maya Lopez, maya.lopez@cityexpo.com, phone +1-415-555-0183. They'll accept deliveries 08:00-18:00. Put "Booth 14B – Redwood/CloudZen" on the label.
Marco R: Manifest attached below (I will paste after pickup). Tentative pickup today 3pm.
Priya S: Speaker run order proposal: 1) 10m intro (Liz), 2) 20m joint demo (Jordan + EdgeForge engineer), 3) 10m roadmap + marketplace CTA (Priya + CloudZen PM), 4) 10m QA. Thoughts?
Jordan K: Run time ok. Request a 15-min tech check slot day before for networking + model warmup. Also request static IP or NAT rule for pulling large layers.
Liz W: Good call. @deploy-bot can you schedule a rehearsal slot for 1 hour on the day before the event (preferred window 2–4pm)?
deploy-bot: Scheduled: "Joint Summit – Tech Rehearsal" on 2026-04-14 15:00–16:00 PDT. Invite sent to Liz W, Marco R, Priya S, Jordan K, Alex N.
Marco R: Manifest:
```
- EdgeForge appliance S/N 12033
- Padding: foam inserts 4x
- Weight: 23kg
- Declared value: $18,500
- HS code: 8471.80
```
Priya S: Swag plan: 500 stickers, 200 tees (mixed sizes), 50 desk plaques (partner co-branded). Shipping split: Redwood covers stickers/tees, CloudZen covers plaques. Need customs invoice for tees (apparel).
Alex N: For desk plaques add a fragile marker and note: "Display Only — not for sale". Venue requires proof of insurance — I have the certificate, will upload to shared drive.
Jordan K: For fallback video: I will record two short segments (live demo, failover script) and upload to the shared folder by Thu EOD.
Liz W: Final items — confirm by Friday: 1) speaker headshots & bios, 2) rehearsal scheduled (confirmed), 3) manifest + customs docs uploaded, 4) co-announcement draft in review. If all green we'll lock the promo date. :thumbsup:
Priya S: On it — will ping legal for marketplace copy approval.
Marco R: Picking up now, will update thread when crate is sealed.
Liz W: Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn. See you at rehearsal. :rocket:
